vibe: Introspective, calm-but-alive, evocative, premium personal space

typography.notes: Do not use default bold. Use font-medium for emphasis. Enforce strict hierarchy. Avoid Inter or Roboto entirely.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-4 for chat bubbles, p-6 for cards, p-8 for sections.

timeline_chat_pattern.user_entries: Right-aligned, max-w-[85%], slightly rounded corners, asymmetric border-radius (e.g., rounded-2xl rounded-br-sm)
timeline_chat_pattern.ai_entries: Left-aligned, max-w-[85%], muted background, rounded-2xl rounded-bl-sm
timeline_chat_pattern.recap_cards: Full width, bento-grid style structure inside, rich background texture.

layout_and_spacing.voice_dock: Floating bottom bar, absolute/fixed positioned, z-50, crystal glassmorphism overlay.

surface_strategies.voice_dock: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark), 1px delicate inner border.
surface_strategies.daily_recap: Neumorphic/Clay blend or flat solid with organic background image, subtle 1px border border-black/5.
surface_strategies.badges: Flat, pill-shaped, muted colors for tags like 'Tasks', 'Reminders'.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and subtle shadow increase for cards. Hover colors must be explicit.
motion_and_interactions.waveform: Live animation during recording, mapped to primary color.
motion_and_interactions.chat_entry: Slide up and fade in entrance animation (staggered for lists).
motion_and_interactions.haptics: Suggest compound gestures (swipe left to archive/dismiss) with simulated haptic feedback.

components_instructions.buttons: Rounded-full for main actions, highly tactile.
components_instructions.inputs: Shadcn based but highly customized. No heavy borders, rely on background contrast.
components_instructions.cards: Avoid generic Shadcn cards. Build custom bento-like containers with generous internal padding (p-6) to avoid text collision.
components_instructions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
